PREFIX  wde:  <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT  ?var1 ?var1Label ?var2 ?var3
WHERE
  { ?var1  wdt:P31  wde:Q7889
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  wdt:P1733  ?var2 }
    ?var1  rdfs:label  ?var1Label
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var1  wikibase:sitelinks  ?var3 }
    FILTER ( lang(?var1Label) = "es" )
  }
GROUP BY ?var1 ?var1Label ?var2 ?var3
ORDER BY DESC(?var3)

    FILTER ( lang(?var3) = "en" )
  }
